description: pkix-ac/src/lib.rs:94-101 — impl std::error::Error for Error returns Some(e) where e: &pkix_path::Error, but pkix_path::Error only implements std::error::Error under #[cfg(feature="std")]. Because pkix-ac/Cargo.toml std feature is [features] std = ["der/std", "x509-cert/std"] without pkix-path/std, building pkix-ac with std gives E0277: pkix_path::Error does not implement std::error::Error. Fix: add pkix-path = { workspace = true, features = ["std"] } to the std feature array in pkix-ac/Cargo.toml: std = ["dep:pkix-path/std", "der/std", "x509-cert/std"].
title: [rusty/pkix-ac] std feature missing pkix-path/std propagation — compile error
